_comment: Issue #25 canonical: Olesm's chess-match payoff (was option+frame-only, a real dead end HANDOFF flagged from playtest). FIXTURE-FIRST (olesm_chess_pre: stage 3 already reached, gold:1 -- ONE SHORT of the 2g wager floor, social_talked pre-set so the first interact opens the real hub directly). Proves, in order: (1) BROKE GREY -- the stage-3-met hub option is visible but LOCKED ('costs 2 gold'), never hidden, never selectable into debt; (2) a REAL Serve (patron_serving, existing content, +2g) covers the shortfall; (3) re-opened, the SAME option is now unlocked; (4) the honest find-the-counter beat -- BOTH wrong moves are entered for real (each loops back to the identical puzzle node with Olesm's in-voice correction, no state change), then the correct move wins: banks chess_with_olesm + the wager's +2g side; (5) the hub option is GONE for good afterward (hide_when on the counter, not a per-waking gate -- this is a one-time authored scene); (6) a real sleep clears social_talked, and the new waking's pool line is the shorter olesm_after_the_match residue (talk_pool_stages' third, newest-wins stage), still absent from the hub the second time around.

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: The board's been out since Tuesday, if you want the honest count. I'm not going to pretend otherwise. Whenever you're ready. I'll even let you have white, which should tell you how confident I am.

steps._comment: 'Sit. Show me.' is visible index 0.

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: Not a fresh game, actually. Same position, move for move: my opening, her replies, right up to the moment I stopped seeing straight. Eleven moves in, my bishop's aimed at your king and I am, in my own defense, feeling rather clever about it. Somewhere in here she found a door I didn't. Find it again and I'll believe two people can see the same board the same way.

steps._comment: 'Set it up.' is visible index 0.
steps.name: confirm

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: Here. Your rook's pinned to the corner, my bishop threatens mate in three if you sit still, and I am rather pleased with myself. Two gold on it, friendly, either way. What's the move?

options.text: Trade the rook. Knight takes, clear the corner.
Queen takes the bishop. End the threat now.
Ignore the bishop. Push the pawn, threaten mate in two instead.
Play it safe. Offer the draw.
